detail.title: Freelance Projects
detail.body: Since 2020 I have been contracted for various freelance web development projects, specializing in custom integrations for Shopify and Webflow. I've always enjoyed the challenge of creating unique solutions for clients, and each project has been an opportunity to learn and broaden my skillset. Here is a gallery of some of my favorite projects I have been a part of.
